refundPolicy.title: CANCELLATION AND REFUND POLICY
refundPolicy.intro: This Cancellation and Refund Policy (the "Policy") establishes the circumstances under which clients of EVOLFY S.A. de C.V. ("WEBALO") may cancel services and, where applicable, obtain a refund.
refundPolicy.integral_part: This Policy is an integral part of the Terms and Conditions available at webalo.com.mx
refundPolicy.section1_item1: Predesigned packages of design and prototypes.
refundPolicy.section1_item3: Any digital deliverable generated by WEBALO (wireframes, prototypes, interfaces, illustrations, audits, redesigns).
refundPolicy.section1_note: Due to the professional and customized nature of the services WEBALO provides, cancellations and refunds are strictly regulated under this Policy.
refundPolicy.section2_intro: The Client may request cancellation only if WEBALO has not initiated any work related to the contracted Service.
refundPolicy.section2_email: The request must be sent in writing to: info@webalo.com.mx
refundPolicy.section2_1_text: If the cancellation is valid (before work begins), the Client may receive a refund of the amount paid, minus:
refundPolicy.section2_1_item2: Bank or payment gateway fees, and
refundPolicy.section2_1_item3: Operational costs incurred in preparing the project start
refundPolicy.section2_2_text: The refund will be processed within a maximum period of fifteen (15) business days following confirmation of the cancellation, and its crediting will be reflected according to the times and policies of the banking institution issuing the card used for payment.
refundPolicy.section3_intro: Once WEBALO has initiated any phase of the project, a full refund does not proceed.
refundPolicy.section3_1_intro: As soon as any of the following actions occur, the project is considered to have started:
refundPolicy.section3_1_item2: Receipt or submission of onboarding forms or documentation.
refundPolicy.section3_1_item4: Generation of wireframes, sketches, ideas, or conceptual structure.
refundPolicy.section3_1_item5: Assignment of team or professionals to the project.
refundPolicy.section3_1_item6: Development of schedules or work plans.
refundPolicy.section3_2_text: In these cases, WEBALO may only grant a partial refund, determined by:
refundPolicy.section3_2_item1: Hours actually worked on the project.
refundPolicy.section3_2_item3: Progress status at the time of cancellation.
refundPolicy.section3_2_note1: The refund will NOT exceed the amount of work not performed.
refundPolicy.section3_2_note2: The calculation will be internal and based solely on the actual project progress.
refundPolicy.section3_3_item1: Final versions, additional adjustments, or review rounds will not be delivered.
refundPolicy.section3_3_item2: Only the progress generated up to the cancellation date will be delivered.
refundPolicy.section3_3_item3: No compensation, bonuses, or credits for future services will be provided.
refundPolicy.section4_intro: WEBALO may only authorize a partial refund, without credits or compensation, in the following cases:
refundPolicy.section4_item1: Proven technical impossibility, beyond the Client's control, making it impossible to complete the project.
refundPolicy.section4_item2: Serious breach by WEBALO, not derived from delays, omissions, or lack of communication from the Client.
refundPolicy.section4_note: In these cases, the partial refund will be calculated exclusively based on:
refundPolicy.section5_text: Custom services are non-refundable once initiated.
refundPolicy.section5_note: Only partial refund based on progress proceeds under the cases in point IV.
refundPolicy.section5_no_title: The following will not be granted:
refundPolicy.section6_title: VI. PROJECTS PAUSED OR ABANDONED BY THE CLIENT
refundPolicy.section6_item2: Does not respond within the agreed timeframes,
refundPolicy.section6_item4: Abandons the project for more than 14 consecutive days,
refundPolicy.section6_note: WEBALO may administratively close the project.
refundPolicy.section6_consequence2: Only the progress generated up to the last working date will be delivered.
refundPolicy.section6_consequence3: To reactivate the project, the Client must contract a new service or an additional quote (this is not a replacement or compensation).
refundPolicy.section7_intro: To request a refund, the Client must send an email to: info@webalo.com.mx
refundPolicy.section7_note1: WEBALO will evaluate the request and respond within a maximum period of 10 business days.
refundPolicy.section7_note2: The refund will be processed within a maximum period of fifteen (15) business days following confirmation of the cancellation, and its crediting will be reflected according to the times and policies of the banking institution issuing the card used for payment.
refundPolicy.section7_note3: The refund will be made through the same payment method originally used.
refundPolicy.section8_title: VIII. NO COMPENSATION OR FUTURE BENEFITS
refundPolicy.section8_item1: NO credits for future services will be granted.
refundPolicy.section8_item3: NO bonuses or discounts will be applied as refund substitutes.
refundPolicy.section8_item5: NO contracted service will be replaced by another.
refundPolicy.section8_note: The sole remedy is partial refund based on progress, when applicable.
refundPolicy.section9_text: WEBALO may modify this Policy at any time to adapt it to operational, legal, or commercial changes.
refundPolicy.section9_note: New versions will be available at: webalo.com.mx
refundPolicy.section9_acceptance: Continued use of the Services after publication implies acceptance of the new version.
refundPolicy.section10_text: For questions, cancellations, or refund requests: info@webalo.com.mx; Avenida Insurgentes Sur No. 605, Floor 8, Suite 802, Colonia Nápoles, Alcaldía Benito Juárez, C.P. 03810, Mexico City.
